label: Point 9.5 cm with Button
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Retail product photograph (1000x1333) of a folded black dress shirt with the brand label 'Paul Fredrick' visible inside the collar band. The collar IS a point collar fastened with buttons: 2 collar-point buttons, one through each leaf tip, holding both leaves flat to the chest; the collar-band throat button is open and no tie is worn, so both leaves are fully visible. Scaling off the collar-point buttons and the placket button (approx 1.1 cm), the point measures roughly 6-7 cm from front neck point to tip - a standard button-down length, not the emphatic 9.5 cm the label names.
